snippet.title: Echo Generation 2 - Official Release Date Trailer | ID@Xbox April 2026 Showcase
snippet.description:
Echo Generation 2 gets a new trailer showcasing gameplay and its sci-fi world, along with a release date announcement. Watch the Echo Generation 2 release date trailer for this upcoming sci-fi deckbuilding RPG. Gather your crew, craft powerful decks, and battle across the stars to find your way home. Deal the cards. Defy the cosmos. Embrace the adventure. Echo Generation 2 will be available on PC, Xbox Series X/S, Xbox on PC, and Xbox Cloud on May 27, 2026.
